Job description:
 In this role you’re continuously following latest technological developments in the area of Cloud in combination with Linux OS.
 Linux Support
Linux Administration: Manage and maintain Linux servers, ensuring optimal performance and security.
Server Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve server issues, ensuring minimal downtime and disruption.
Azure: Work with Azure cloud services to deploy, manage, and scale applications.
Password Management: Implement and manage secure password policies and practices.
LVM (Logical Volume Manager): Configure and manage LVM for efficient storage management.
Chef Automation: Utilize Chef for configuration management and automation of server tasks.
 Ansible Administration:
Fundamentals: Understand the basics of Ansible and its core components.
Collection on Ansible Roles: Develop and manage Ansible roles and playbooks.
Working Knowledge: Apply Ansible for automation of administrative tasks and infrastructure management.
Administrative Tasks: Perform administrative tasks using Ansible to ensure smooth operations.
 Profile description:
 Qualifications & Experience
Minimum Requirements
Fluency in English;
Azure Associate certification or equivalent knowledge level.
Linux (RHEL and or SLES) and Ansible certification.
At least 5 years of working experience
Previous working experience with Terraform, Python and Ansible Automation Platform
Working experience with at least 1 of the following: Prometheus, RedHat IPA, and OpenShift/Kubernetes or other Container solutions.
Knowledge of CI/CD concepts and toolset (i.e. Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
Good analytical and problem-solving skills to resolve technical issues.
Understanding of Agile development, SCRUM or SRE concepts is a plus.
Willing to run standby duty
Able to function autonomously and add to a collaborative team-spirit.
 What do we offer?
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform (possibility of choosing flexible benefits like meal tickets, medical coverage for employees and dependents at Regina Maria, private pension, sport subscription, etc.)
25 vacation days/year.
Life Insurance cover.
Eyeglasses cost reimbursement: 1500 RON to be claimed every 3 years
Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
In the first 8 weeks, the company will pay the difference of up to 100% for the parental leave granted to pregnant employees.
Unfortunate events allowance of 7000 RON for first degree relative granted from day 1 in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.
